desc: Derive ratio chain and identify coprime-split branching (2^{ω(A_i)} choices per index)
Model per-prime independently: exponent walk with steps ±e_i, shift forced so min exponent = 0 (gcd condition)
Design DP over height above running minimum with area-accumulated weights ℓ^E; verify on sample 2 (→18) and sample 1 (→939634344) by hand
Implement final solution: SPF factorization of A_i, group (index, exponent) per prime, numpy DP with gap compression, multiply per-prime sums mod 998244353
Validate edge cases (all A_i = 1 → answer 1; single-step primes; trailing/leading flat gaps) and confirm complexity fits N ≤ 1000
